t: The Calls page lists every call you made or got: who, when, how long, and the ones you missed.
In this video, you will learn how to read your call history, find missed calls, call back, and clear your list.
To open this page, click Calls in the left menu.
At the top are the numbers for the last thirty days: calls, missed calls, talk time, and people called.
Below is the list of calls, newest first, grouped by day.
On the right is your team, with a Call button for everyone.
Use the tabs to see All, Missed, Incoming or Outgoing calls.
Search by name finds your calls with one person.
On any call, press Call to call back, or Chat to open your chat with them.
To clear calls from your list, press Select, tick the calls, and press Delete selected.
This only clears your own list. Nobody else's history changes.
Next in the Talk menu: Files.
